URL: https://linear.app/shel-bernstein/issue/SHE-259/hbl-play-01-world-run-cycle-hangs-on-simulating-without-the-plan-while

Found while playtesting /world on Nov 12.

## What happened

1. Opened /world, set Plan package to **Balanced** and clicked **Run cycle**.
2. The panel showed "Simulating without the plan…" for 35+ seconds and never finished.
3. Directly below, the experiment status still read **Idle** and "No completed run yet."
4. There was no progress bar, no cancel button, and no error. Clicking Storm while it was hanging made no difference.

* A progress indicator shows while the run is in flight, with a cancel button.
* Playwright journey: pick Balanced → Run cycle → results panel visible within budget.

Status: Backlog (backlog)

## Problem

No ticket tests whether a quest-selection director beats random quest choice on the same seeds. Yu, Guzdial and Sturtevant (AIIDE 2024, DOI 10.1609/aiide.v20i1.31885) report that, in a human-subject study on a different test bed (FarmQuest), a non-random AI director gave better player experience than random selection. That result came from their setting, not HBL's. Here it is a hypothesis to test.

## Player story

When the game offers my next quest, it fits what I just did, not a random pick.

## Scientific justification

A director result is only meaningful next to a random baseline run on the same seeds.

## Scope

1. One director policy and one random policy, on the same build and the same seeds.
2. At least 100 paired seeds. Each seed runs both policies.
3. Write the metrics before any run: quest completion rate, time to first quest, and quests abandoned.
4. Null check: two random policies with different labels should show no systematic difference.

## Out of scope

* New quest content.
* Any claim about fun before the paired results are posted.
* Player surveys. These need a separate consent ticket.

## Acceptance criteria

* Metric list and stop rule committed to the repo before the first run.
* Paired results reported with effect size and an interval.
* Null check result reported.
* A note listing what was not measured.

## Dependencies
